latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release providing guided selection and execution of discovery framing techniques for product teams.

- Helps classify product efforts (typical, large, or new product/business) and matches them with the appropriate framing tool: Opportunity Assessment, Customer Letter, or Startup Canvas.
- Guides users through input gathering and decision steps to clarify the problem before any discovery work begins.
- Produces a structured framing document to align teams on what problem they are solving.
- Recommended when value risk is High or the problem is not well defined, especially before ideation, prototyping, or delivery planning.
